units.en: The same source adds: In Later Zhou Guangshun, Zhang Zhao revised the Veritable Records and proposed that Zhu Yougui, who had murdered his way to the throne above the Last Emperor, be entered—as with Liu Shao in the 《History of Song》—under the title "Arch-rebel Zhu Yougui."
units.literal: Also recorded: In the Guangshun era of Zhou, Zhang Zhao revised the Veritable Records, memorializing: Above the Last Emperor of Liang was Prince of Ying Zhu Yougui, who usurped and murdered and held the throne, with no record yet—request according to 《Song History》 Liu Shao's precedent to write as "Arch-rebel Zhu Yougui."

units.zh: 與懷朔省事雲中司馬子如及秀容人劉貴、中山人賈顯智為奔走之友，懷朔戶曹史孫騰、外兵史侯景亦相友結。
units.en: He made running companions of Sima Ziru, affairs clerk at Huaishuo's Yunzhong desk, Liu Gui of Xiurong, and Jia Xianzhi of Zhongshan; Sun Teng, the garrison household clerk, and Hou Jing, clerk for external military affairs, joined their circle as well.
units.literal: With Sima Ziru, affairs clerk of Yunzhong at Huaishuo, Liu Gui of Xiurong, and Jia Xianzhi of Zhongshan he formed a band of comrades ready to run errands; Sun Teng, household clerk at Huaishuo, and Hou Jing, clerk in external military affairs, also joined in friendship.

units.zh: 蕭穎胄旣都督中外諸軍事，論者謂高祖應致牋，域爭不聽，乃止。
units.en: When Xiao Yingzhou became area commander of all armies, some said Gaozu should send a formal letter of submission; Yu objected and the idea was dropped.
units.literal: When Xiao Yingzhou became area commander of all armies, some said Gaozu should send a formal letter of submission; Yu objected and the idea was dropped.

units.zh: 蕭子恪 弟子範 子顯 子雲
units.en: Xiao Zike; his younger brother Zifan; Xiao Zixian; Xiao Ziyun
units.literal: Xiao Zike; his younger brother Zifan; Zixian; Ziyun

units.zh: 子恪與弟子範等，嘗因事入謝，高祖在文德殿引見之，從容謂曰：「我欲與卿兄弟有言。
units.en: Zike and his younger brother Zifan and the others once came to court to offer thanks on official business. Emperor Wu received them in the Wende Hall and said at his ease, "I wish to speak with you brothers.
units.literal: Zike and his younger brother Zifan and others once entered to give thanks on an affair; the High Ancestor received them in the Wende Hall and said at ease, "I wish to have words with you brothers.

units.zh: 蕭子恪，字景沖，蘭陵人，齊豫章文獻王嶷第二子也。
units.en: Xiao Zike, styled Jingchong, came from Lanling and was the second son of Yi, Prince Wenxian of Yuzhang under Qi.
units.literal: Xiao Zike, styled Jingchong, came from Lanling and was the second son of Yi, Prince Wenxian of Yuzhang under Qi.

units.zh: 卿是宗室，情義異佗，方坦然相期，卿無復懷自外之意。
units.en: You are of the imperial clan; your bond differs from others. I openly expect much of you—do not harbor thoughts of standing apart.
units.literal: You are of the imperial clan; your bond differs from others. I openly expect much of you; do not harbor thoughts of standing apart.

units.zh: 穎胄暴卒，州府騷擾，闡文以和帝幼弱，中流任重，時始興王憺留鎮雍部，用與西朝羣臣迎王總州事，故賴以寧輯。
units.en: Yingzhou died suddenly and the province shook; Chanwen said the emperor was young and the midstream heavy—Prince of Shixing Dan held Yong, and Chanwen with western ministers brought him to head the province and calm the land.
units.literal: When Yingzhou died suddenly, the province and prefecture were in turmoil; Chanwen held that Emperor He was young and weak while the midstream bore heavy responsibility—at the time the Prince of Shixing, Dan, was left to guard Yong, and Chanwen joined the western court ministers in welcoming the prince to take overall charge of the province, and through this order was restored.

units.zh: 治民如子賤，踐境有成，折獄如仲由，片辭從理。
units.en: They govern like Zijian and wherever they step succeed; they judge like Zhong You and a single phrase decides right.
units.literal: They govern the people like Zijian and set foot in a district with success; they judge cases like Zhong You and a single phrase decides right.

units.zh: 覽頗樂酒，因醼席與散騎常侍蕭琛辭相詆毀，爲有司所奏。
units.en: Lan loved wine; at a feast he and Regular Attendant Xiao Chen traded insults, and the authorities memorialized against them.
units.literal: Lan was quite fond of wine; at a banquet with Regular Attendant of the Writes-on-the-Fast Xiao Chen they exchanged abusive words and were reported by the authorities.

units.zh: 天監元年，爲中書侍郎，掌吏部事，頃之卽真。
units.en: In Tianjian 1, Lan became Gentleman of the Secretariat and handled Personnel affairs; before long he took the office in his own right.
units.literal: In Tianjian 1, Lan became Gentleman of the Secretariat and handled Personnel affairs; before long he took the office in his own right.

units.zh: 遷平西邵陵王長史。
units.en: He was transferred to chief clerk to the Prince of Shaoling, General Who Pacifies the West.
units.literal: He was transferred to Chief Clerk to the Prince of Shaoling, General Who Pacifies the West.

units.zh: 起家梁祕書郎，歷太子舍人，輕車河東王主簿，安前邵陵王、中軍宣
units.en: He began as a Liang secretariat gentleman, then served as crown prince aide, registrar to the prince of Hedong of the light chariots, and merit clerk in the households of the former prince of Shaoling and the central army prince Xuan
units.literal: He first entered office as a Liang Secretariat Gentleman, then served as Aide to the Crown Prince, Registrar to the Prince of Hedong of the Light Chariots, and Merit Clerk in the two prefectures of the preceding Prince of Shaoling and the Central Army Prince Xuan

units.zh: 安前邵陵王中軍宣
units.en: Preceding prince of Shaoling, central army prince Xuan
units.literal: Preceding Prince of Shaoling, Central Army Prince Xuan
